descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S02 Ten-sentence set, Nursing Home half (N-01…N-05): pre-round notes through GPT-live

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 4)
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 5)
  • U5 The speech-to-text engine used is recorded for every run (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when the ambient option is on), alongside the note model. (UAT TC-23; UAT 3.9; TFA-94423 AC 7)
  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (TFA-94423 AC 1; TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09))

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Same account as S01; one synthetic Nursing Home resident with no pre-round note today

When Each sentence is spoken into the resident's pre-round notes box with Dictate, then Stop, one per take into an empty box

Then Each box holds its sentence once with exactly the dictated numbers in order, correct (or flagged) drug names, 37.9 still in Celsius, micrograms still micrograms; each take has exactly one gpt-live-transcribe prepareSession row and no transcribeAudio row

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Same per-sentence rule as S01 (numbers, boundaries, occurrences). Nursing Home is scored x/5 on its own and pooled with S01 as x/10 (3.2, 3.3, Q4): 'passes in both modes' is not reported while either mode has a failure. Engine per take as S01. Every failure quoted. Synthetic voice is a pre-check of U6/T5; acceptance is S19

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

Not judged yet: the Nursing Home dictation-fidelity run is blocked on the same local OpenAI key approval.

Evidence: allure-results/edbb12ba…: same OpenAI-key precondition block. Scripted self-test 5/5.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-23/S01; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

The scripted self-test behind this entry ran before the review fix and used the real prepareSession: each take minted one OpenAI client secret (client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on api.openai.com) with the local key …PUMA — no audio, but the gated key was used.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions)..
